comment: Transitional billing cutover tools allowed to exist in Sub only until their deletion trigger fires. Each entry is owner-approved surface under the thin-client gate: no entry may grow beyond baseline_lines, and no detected transitional tool may exist without an entry here.

tools.purpose: One-time opening-balance targets for customer-subledger completion; read-only resolver over frozen audit restore.
tools.deletion_trigger: Delete when the Starter ledger switch completes and opening positions are sealed in dotmac-billing.

tools.purpose: Read-only opening/cash-receipt evidence census export for the Starter cutover (PRs #3600/#3606).
tools.deletion_trigger: Delete after the opening import is sealed in dotmac-billing and the final rehearsal artifact is archived.

tools.purpose: Typed contracts for the opening evidence census export.
tools.deletion_trigger: Delete with opening_export.py after the opening import is sealed in dotmac-billing.

tools.purpose: Read-only disjoint invoice-numbering candidate proof; never authorizes activation.
tools.deletion_trigger: Delete when Starter numbering is activated for Sub and the disjointness proof is archived.

tools.purpose: Read-only numbering readiness observation for the Starter numbering cutover.
tools.deletion_trigger: Delete when Starter numbering is activated for Sub.

tools.purpose: CLI entry for the read-only numbering activation proof.
tools.deletion_trigger: Delete with billing_numbering_activation_proof.py when Starter numbering is activated.

tools.purpose: CLI entry for numbering readiness observation.
tools.deletion_trigger: Delete with billing_numbering_readiness.py when Starter numbering is activated.

tools.purpose: CLI entry for the read-only opening evidence census export.
tools.deletion_trigger: Delete with opening_export.py after the opening import is sealed in dotmac-billing.

tools.purpose: Read-only census-to-observation assembly for the opening rehearsal (Step 5); translates the opening census preview onto the pinned dotmac-billing rehearsal observation contract.
tools.deletion_trigger: Delete after the opening import is sealed in dotmac-billing and the final rehearsal artifact is archived.

tools.purpose: Read-only serializer rendering the typed opening census preview to the exact JSON document Starter's rehearsal adapter consumes (Step 5).
tools.deletion_trigger: Delete after the opening import is sealed in dotmac-billing and the final rehearsal artifact is archived.
